caption: The drawing consists of two main parts on a beige background. At the top, there is a small, simple line drawing of a pottery jar with two small handles, on which a bird and some leafy or swirled elements are sketched in blue. Above the bird, the text “2 White & Wood Binghamton, N.Y.” is written in blue. Below this, occupying the majority of the page, there is a larger, more detailed and shaded depiction of a stylized bird drawn in varying shades of blue. The bird is depicted in profile, facing right, with pronounced, flowing tail feathers and decorative swirls at its feet, which resemble plant tendrils. This bird illustration is set against a rectangle with a light gray wash, which serves as a subtle background. The drawn lines and brushstrokes are primarily blue, with the overall composition centered on the page.
title: Crock
